rabba-bar-avuh.name: Rabba bar Avuh
rabba-bar-avuh.bio: Babylonian Amora of the second generation whose teachings Rav Naḥman often transmits.
rabba-bar-avuh.prompt: A dignified, gentle Babylonian scholar in his 60s with a full grey beard and a patient, teaching expression, holding a few fragrant green leaves in a fold of his cloak (from the story that Elijah led him into the Garden of Eden); background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-yosei-bar-yehuda.name: Rabbi Yosei bar Yehuda
rabbi-yosei-bar-yehuda.bio: Tanna cited in baraitot under this name.
rabbi-yosei-bar-yehuda.prompt: A composed scholar of the Land of Israel in his 40s with a short dark beard and a precise, measuring look, one hand resting on a small silver coin; background of a Galilean stone study hall in soft lamplight.
